title: fix(metadata-protocol): the bare member read serves an App pair's declared override of a bundle addition's own member (ADR-0150 D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNTugWasvhTMrtCZiFGrZYK)_

Part of #32849 (the bare member read and the bare execution read; the bare layered read's `effective` exit stays open on #32849 and follows after #32622 lands)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：App 的 `.custom` pair 存了一行邮件模板 `fr-FR`,声明覆盖附加包 Z(`overrides.package: Z`),而 `fr-FR` 正是 Z 自己发的成员(X 发 `en-US`)。以前不带包的裸读 `?member=fr-FR`(以及不带包的执行读)给出 Z 原版 `zeta fr-FR`,把声明的覆盖丢了;现在给出覆盖,与 `?package=Z`、Z 的列表、注册表在 Z 的槽位一致。
- 为什么改:声明了的覆盖应当在每个给出 Z 该成员的出口被服务(ADR-0146 D8 第 2 项、ADR-0150 D4);裸读给 Z 原版等于静默丢掉已声明的定制。
- 风险与回滚:只在“名字有两个以上发包、该成员只有一个已启用的发包、且存在该发包的已声明覆盖行”时生效;两个包都发该成员、行声明的是别的包(#32606 形态)、未声明的 pair 行、环境自有条目、发包已停用、严格草稿读均不变(对照测试已固定)。回滚即还原本 PR,存储数据不变。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts` 的 `declaredMemberOverrideAddressOf` 与 `readMetaItemFace` 里 `servedAddress` 的 `??` 一行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts -t 32849`,预期 5 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`readMetaItemFace` (the one body behind `getMetaItem` and `getMetaItemForExecution`) gains one arm after the served-holder judgment: `declaredMemberOverrideAddressOf`. For a read naming no package and naming a bundle member, when two or more packages ship the name, exactly one enabled package S ships the member, no environment item of the member exists, and an active row of that member is S's served override (`isServedOverrideRowOf`, the one spelling of that predicate: bound to S's pair, declaring `overrides.package` S), the read is taken at S. It then serves what `?package=S&member=...` serves.

Why the bare read missed it: its content package is `packagelessContentPackage` over the name's shippers (X and Z) and the active rows' bindings (the pair only, no shipper), which answers `null` (the package-unbound row alone), so the declared override was never a candidate and the read fell through to Z's shipped member.

The rows the arm reads go through the face's `readItemActiveRows` wrapper, so `readMetaItem` takes them instead of reading them again. No `protocol.ts` or registry edit.

| read (both registration orders) | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| bare `?member=fr-FR`, row declares Z | `zeta fr-FR` | `pair fr-FR`, stamped Z, envelope Z |
| bare execution read, `member: fr-FR`, row declares Z | `zeta fr-FR` | `pair fr-FR`, stamped Z |
| `?package=Z&member=fr-FR` | `pair fr-FR` | unchanged |
| bare `?member=en-US` (X's own) | `suitex en-US` | unchanged |
| bare `?member=fr-FR`, no row / undeclared pair row | `zeta fr-FR` | unchanged |
| bare `?member=fr-FR`, row declares X (#32606 shape) | 409 naming X and Z | unchanged |

## Tests

`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`, in the #32561 block that already holds this arrangement (real `SchemaRegistry`, beside the #32606 pins):

- `[#32849] the bare member read serves the pair's declared override of an addition Z's own locale, as Z's address does` (addition installed first / row stored first).
- `[#32849] CONTROL — no override of Z declared` (no row stored / an undeclared pair row of the locale): Z's own `fr-FR`.
- `[#32849] CONTROL — the row declares X (the #32606 shape)`: 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both, not moved to Z.

<details><summary>Ablations (source mutated through ablation-replace, metadata-protocol rebuilt, marker proved in dist, restored blob equals HEAD, rebuilt, marker proved absent)</summary>

| | mutation | result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | the arm's call in `readMetaItemFace` replaced by `undefined` | 2 failed (both orders of the fix pin): `bare ?member=fr-FR: expected [ 'zeta fr-FR', 'com.acme.zeta', …(1) ] to deeply equal [ 'pair fr-FR', 'com.acme.zeta', …(1) ]`; 3 CONTROLs green |
| A2 | `isServedOverrideRowOf(row, shipper, installed)` replaced by `true` (any row of the member re-addresses) | 1 failed: the X-declared CONTROL, `the read answered; a refusal was expected`; 4 green |

After each restore: `git diff HEAD` empty, blob `ec8a3e1c` equals HEAD, `Tests 5 passed`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The two no-override CONTROLs stay green under A2 by construction: re-addressed to Z, Z's exact read answers Z's own `fr-FR`, the same answer. They pin the unchanged outcome; A2 shows the X-declared CONTROL is the one that catches an arm that ignores the declaration.
- Measured through the protocol with a real `SchemaRegistry` and stored rows, the harness #32606 used; not through the HTTP save door.
